title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 6: Outpost

scenes.say: They send the unit to an outpost at the edge of nowhere.
scenes.visual: a small fortified outpost on a desert hill, sandbags and wire, dusk, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Twelve men. Two walls. One road in.
scenes.visual: soldiers on watch behind sandbag walls, scanning a lonely road, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Nights stretch forever. Every sound is a threat.
scenes.visual: night vision green view of an empty desert landscape, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali takes the late watch so the young boys can sleep.
scenes.visual: a soldier on watch at night, silhouetted against stars, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A private asks him, Sarge, how you stay so calm?
scenes.visual: two soldiers talking quietly on a rooftop at night, faces in shadow, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I grew up with sirens for a lullaby, he says.
scenes.visual: red and blue light glow reflected on a city window, memory haze, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Newark made him hard. The Army made him useful.
scenes.visual: a soldier checking his gear methodically at dawn, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: For the first time, somebody looks up to him for the right reasons.
scenes.visual: a young soldier watching an older one teach him to clean a rifle, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He realizes leading is just protecting, on purpose.
scenes.visual: a soldier standing at the outpost gate as the sun rises, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Every man walks off that hill alive.
scenes.visual: a convoy leaving the outpost at sunrise, dust trailing, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Seven. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a sergeant's stripes on a uniform sleeve, close up, golden light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 6 of 25: Outpost. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
